summary.description: 120-200 word overview of what this monthly report covers and what is notable in it

highlights.description: 4-8 notable events, decisions or figures reported this month, each at most 25 words

printed_toc_found.description: true if the report has its own printed table of contents

title.description: Heading as printed, in normal title case, e.g. 'Part II: Political' or 'Public Safety'

level.description: 1 = part or top-level division, 2 = section within a part, 3 = subsection (use sparingly)

printed_page.description: Page number printed in the report's own table of contents or on the page, if any; empty otherwise

start_page.description: PDF page number (from the <!-- page N --> marker) where this heading actually appears

end_page.description: Last PDF page of this section

summary.description: 1-2 sentences on what this section reports this month (at most 45 words); for a level-1 part that only contains sections, a few words suffice
